package.name: samba
package.description: Tools to access a server's filespace and printers via SMB (Werewolf: no PAM)

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/samba-team/samba.git https://git.samba.org/samba.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 02e8e3f93f4af787bcb3389cbff9e22e74567eb2; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 02e8e3f93f4af787bcb3389cbff9e22e74567eb2
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 02e8e3f93f4af787bcb3389cbff9e22e74567eb2
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "02e8e3f93f4af787bcb3389cbff9e22e74567eb2: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

install -d -m755 "${{targets.destdir}}"/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d
sed 's, /var/run/samba , /run/samba ,' packaging/systemd/samba.conf.tmp >"${{targets.destdir}}"/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/samba.conf
# We only need /run/samba, not /var/run/samba; merged-varrun ensures
# they refer to the same directory.
rmdir "${{targets.destdir}}"/var/run/samba

pipeline.name: Check Installed Binaries
pipeline.runs:
find /usr -name smbd
find /usr -name nmbd

pipeline.name: Check smbd Installation
pipeline.runs:
if [ -f /usr/bin/smbd ]; then
  echo "smbd found in /usr/bin."
else
  echo "smbd could not be found in /usr/bin!" && exit 1
fi

pipeline.name: Check nmbd Installation
pipeline.runs:
if [ -f /usr/bin/nmbd ]; then
  echo "nmbd found in /usr/bin."
else
  echo "nmbd could not be found in /usr/bin!" && exit 1
fi

pipeline.name: Test smbd Service Start
pipeline.runs:
TMP_CONF=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP_CONF" <<'EOF'
[global]
log file = /dev/stdout
[public]
path = /tmp
read only = no
EOF
smbd -i -s "$TMP_CONF" &
SMBD_PID=$!
sleep 2
if kill -0 $SMBD_PID; then
  echo "smbd started successfully."
  kill $SMBD_PID
else
  echo "smbd failed to start!" && exit 1
fi
rm "$TMP_CONF"

pipeline.name: No PAM module, and nothing Samba installs loads libpam
pipeline.runs:
cat > /tmp/samba-probe.sh <<'WEREWOLF_SAMBA_PROBE'
# The installed Samba holds Werewolf's build policy: no PAM module, and no
# server program or Samba library that loads libpam.
set -eu

if [ -e /usr/lib/security/pam_winbind.so ]; then
	echo 'Samba installed pam_winbind.so' >&2
	exit 1
fi
test -e /usr/lib/samba/libauth-private-samba.so
for file in /usr/bin/smbd /usr/bin/nmbd /usr/lib/samba/*.so* /usr/lib/libsmbconf.so* \
	/usr/lib/libsamba-*.so*; do
	test -e "$file" || continue
	if grep -q 'libpam\.so' "$file"; then
		echo "$file names libpam" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
done
WEREWOLF_SAMBA_PROBE
sh /tmp/samba-probe.sh
